text_block_list.name: Anne
text_block_list.text:
Phew! We did it!
All thanks to that power of yours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅー！
　やったね！
あなたのおかげだよー！

text_block_list.name: Anne
text_block_list.text:
There are still plenty of foes left, though,
so let's keep it up!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ相手は尽きないけど……
一緒に頑張ろうね！
